## Clinical justification

This 14-year-old patient has a soft tissue lump on the left thigh for six weeks, increasing in size. On examination: approximately 5cm, deep to the deep fascia, firm, non-tender. Overlying skin normal. I have arranged an urgent ultrasound scan as part of this referral. I was advised by the local sarcoma team by telephone to refer via the paediatric sarcoma pathway for patients of this age. The telephone advice from the local team was given prior to this referral today.
